guidance.translation: Я не видела, как он руководит командой, поэтому судить об этом не могу. Его нынешний график подтвердить не могу — уточните, пожалуйста, у него.

exercises.hint: В M4 две новые обязанности: вести занятие одной и утверждать покупки до $3,000. Плюс каждая суббота.
answers: I haven't observed Leila leading a session alone or approving purchases on her own, so I can't comment on those duties. I also can't confirm her current Saturday availability; please ask her directly.

Those duties go beyond what I observed. I never saw Leila lead a session without a manager or approve spending of up to $3,000, so I can't comment on that. Please ask her directly about Saturdays, because I can't confirm her current schedule.
exercises.explanation: Засчитывается, если обе новые обязанности названы как граница знания, а не как недостаток, и вопрос о субботах передан Лейле. She isn't ready for that — оценка, для которой у Ruth нет фактов.

exercises.prompt: Напиши Dr. Ward полное рекомендательное письмо на 150–180 слов, включая обращение и подпись. Пиши для роли из M1 — изменения из M4 пока не учитывай. Что должно быть: обращение; кого и на какую должность рекомендуешь и откуда её знаешь; абзац об организации с примером (можно с ошибкой и исправлением); абзац об общении с примером и осторожным выводом; одна честная граница; рекомендация и предложение ответить на вопросы; Sincerely, имя и должность. Устройство письма можно посмотреть в M3, но факты об Owen не переносить.
exercises.hint: План: Dear Dr. Ward: → I'm pleased to recommend… I supervised… → Leila is well organized… → She also communicates… This suggests… → I haven't observed… → I recommend… → Sincerely, Ruth Ellis, Program Supervisor, Harbor Rooms
answers:
Dear Dr. Ward:

I'm pleased to recommend Leila Hassan for the Community Learning Coordinator position. I supervised her at Harbor Rooms from March 2025 to May 2026. I attended six of the ten workshops she helped organize and reviewed the planning records for all ten.

Leila is well organized. She made schedules for four volunteers and checked room bookings. In November 2025, she missed a room change on one list. She corrected it that afternoon and started a dated checklist, and the next three updates I checked were correct.

She also communicates patiently. When a visitor said the instructions were too small to read, Leila listened, asked what would help and gave the visitor a large-print copy. This suggests that she listens before she acts.

Her records of small, approved purchases were accurate. I haven't observed her managing a budget on her own, but your role doesn't require that at first.

I recommend Leila for the position and would be glad to answer any questions.

Sincerely,
Ruth Ellis
Program Supervisor, Harbor Rooms
exercises.explanation: Засчитывается, если все пункты на месте, каждый факт есть в M2, а вывод осторожный. Двоеточие после Dear Dr. Ward — формат делового письма; в письме по e-mail допустима и запятая. Фразы вроде “She is the best coordinator I've ever met” без примера не засчитываются.

exercises.prompt: Dr. Ward звонит тебе (M4). Ответь ей вслух, 1–2 минуты. Что должно быть: спасибо и что новые обязанности шире того, что ты видела; что ты можешь подтвердить — два-три факта из M2; чего ты не видела — без оценки «не умеет»; насчёт суббот — к Лейле; остаётся ли в силе твоя рекомендация и для какой части роли; один вопрос о пробном периоде (trial period), помня, что он ещё не решён. Скажи, запиши и сверь с M2 и M4.
exercises.context: my recommendation still stands — моя рекомендация остаётся в силе.
exercises.hint: План: Thank you for… Those duties go beyond… → What I can confirm is… → I never saw… → Please ask her… → My recommendation still stands for… → Would a manager…?
answers: Thank you for letting me know. Those duties go beyond what I observed at Harbor Rooms. What I can confirm is this: Leila helped organize ten Saturday workshops, she made the volunteer schedules, and her records of small purchases were accurate. Those purchases were between $40 and $120, and a manager had already approved them. I never saw her lead a session alone or approve spending on her own, so I can't comment on purchases of up to $3,000. I also can't confirm whether she's available every Saturday now; please ask her directly. My recommendation still stands for the organization and communication I saw, but the new duties would need a separate check. If you do have a trial period, would a manager review all her budget decisions during that time? I understand that nothing has been decided yet.
exercises.explanation: Засчитывается, если ответ разделяет «могу подтвердить», «не видела» и «спросите у неё», а пробный период остаётся предложением. “She can't do that” — оценка без фактов, “Yes, she's ready” — обещание без фактов. Расшифровка проверит слова, но не произношение.

exercises.prompt: Коллега написал за тебя черновик обновлённого письма. Перепиши его в точное письмо Dr. Ward на 140–180 слов с учётом M4. Черновик: “Dear Dr. Ward, I strongly recommend Leila for every part of the new role. I watched all ten of her workshops and can confirm she worked completely independently. She alone increased attendance from twelve to eighteen. Leila never makes mistakes and has already managed big budgets, so approving $3,000 will be easy for her. She is a certified project management expert. I guarantee she is available every Saturday. We have agreed that a manager will review her decisions at first, although that won't be necessary. Sincerely, Ruth Ellis”
exercises.context: certified — с подтверждённым сертификатом; independently — самостоятельно.
exercises.hint: Проверь каждую фразу по M2 и M4: видела сама, проверила, знаешь с её слов или это выдумка?
answers:
Dear Dr. Ward:

Thank you for explaining the new duties. I supervised Leila Hassan at Harbor Rooms from March 2025 to May 2026. I attended six of the ten workshops she helped organize and reviewed the records for all ten.

Leila made clear volunteer schedules and communicated patiently with visitors. When a colleague noticed a missed room change, she corrected the list the same afternoon and started a dated checklist. Attendance rose during a team campaign, so I can't separate her part.

Her records of small purchases approved by a manager were accurate. However, I haven't observed her approving spending on her own or leading a session without a manager. Her résumé mentions a project management course, but I haven't seen the certificate. I can't confirm her Saturday availability; please ask her directly.

I still recommend Leila for the organization and communication I observed. The new duties would need a separate check, and a trial period with a manager's review may be worth discussing.

Sincerely,
Ruth Ellis
Program Supervisor, Harbor Rooms
exercises.explanation: Исправлено: all ten → шесть из десяти; independently и She alone → граница и общий итог команды; never makes mistakes → честный случай с исправлением; big budgets и certified expert → «не видела» и «из резюме»; guarantee и We have agreed → «спросите у неё» и «может, стоит обсудить». Засчитывается любая версия без выдумок и без обратной крайности — “She can't handle it”.

keyRule.rule: Пиши о том, что видел сам. Чего не видел — так и скажи.
keyRule.example: I saw her rewrite the guide after feedback. I haven't seen her manage a budget. — Я видела, как она переписала инструкцию после отзывов. Как она ведёт бюджет, я не видела.
keyRule.check: “She never makes mistakes” — ты можешь это доказать? Нет — убери.
